interval_method.difference: Newcombe independent two-proportions Wilson hybrid 95%, no continuity correction

limitations: No p-values or significance/no-effect claims are generated.
Intervals are individual, unadjusted comparisons and presume independent calls.
Invalid-output identification ranges are not confidence intervals.
Only four fixed text profiles are described; no student-population inference.
No inference is made for effects with an endpoint having zero completed calls.
A partial run may have unequal cell completion and does not substitute for the full planned experiment.
missingness_rule: Calls lacking a final record are not_completed; excluded from all outcome denominators, never imputed as failures or zero actions
primary_definition: Count(valid AND action == study) / completed; invalid completions are not interpreted as observed non-study behavior
validity_rule: error_code empty AND parse_status ok AND finish_reason stop/eos AND not truncated AND action in legal seven-action set; runner eligibility/action-indicator flags are not used
